description: The EPPO Global Database holds the pest-specific information produced or collected by the European and Mediterranean Plant Protection Organization. It gives basic information on more than 99,700 species of interest to agriculture, forestry and plant protection, including scientific and common names, taxonomy and EPPO Codes, and detailed information on more than 1,900 regulated pests: geographical distribution with a world map, host plants, quarantine status, and where relevant vectors and biological control agents. It also holds EPPO datasheets and pest risk analyses, EPPO Standards, more than 17,000 pictures and the articles of the EPPO Reporting Service since 1974. It is maintained by the EPPO Secretariat and updated continuously. Coverage is global. It is free to search online; free registration adds batch queries and newsletters. Caveats: the page read states no data licence, only a citation form, distribution records depend on official and published reports, and the EPPO Codes are a controlled vocabulary whose new entries carry fees. For simulation it provides pest distributions and host lists used to model how invasive pests and plant diseases spread through crops and trade, and to plan phytosanitary emergency response. It is related to the FAO Locust Watch record in this catalogue, which tracks one migratory pest.
